content.title: ‘Something Very Bad Is Going To Happen’ Rotten Tomatoes Reviews Are Very Good
content.text: Camilla Marrone in "Something Very Bad is About to Happen."NETFLIXThe Duffer Brothers’ and Haley Z. Boston’s new Netflix horror series Something Very Bad is Going to Happen is new on streaming, and Rotten Tomatoes critics have some good things to say about it.Something Very Bad is Going to Happen marks the first series executive produced by Matt Duffer and Ross Duffer since the conclusion of their landmark Netflix series Stranger Things. Created by Boston (Guillermo del Toro’s Cabinet of Curiosities) with two of the eight episodes in the series directed by Baby Reindeer director Weronika Tofilska, Something Very Bad is Going to Happen debuted on Netflix on Thursday.ForbesWhy Rachel From ‘Something Very Bad Is Going To Happen’ Looks FamiliarBy Tim LammersThe official summary for Something Very Bad is Going to Happen reads, “If Carrie is horror’s version of a girl becoming a woman, and Rosemary’s Baby is the horrific version of a woman becoming a mother, Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen is horror’s take on a woman becoming a wife. Rachel (Camila Morrone) is getting married in five days.“Together with her fiancé, Nicky (Adam DiMarco), she embarks on a road trip to his family's vacation home, secluded in a snowy forest, for the intimate wedding ceremony of their dreams. Which really would be so lovely, except ... prone to superstition and paranoia, Rachel can't shake the relentless feeling that something bad is going to happen. Her foreboding doubts, coupled with a series of eerie coincidences and dreadful surprises, force her to ask the question: What makes two people soulmates? And worse — what could be scarier than lifelong commitment to the wrong person?”MORE FOR YOUForbesJosh Duhamel On Why It’s Not An Actor’s Job To Preach PoliticsBy Tim LammersAs of Friday, Something Very Bad is Going to Happen has received an 83% “fresh” critics’ score on Rotten Tomatoes’ Tomatometer based on 30 reviews. The RT Critics Consensus for the series reads, “Marrying horror and atmospheric storytelling to thrilling effect, Something Very Bad is Going to Happen ably transports newlywed jitters to the surrealist realm of binge-worthy TV.” Email Address The series also has earned a 70% “fresh” score on RT’s Popcornmeter based on less than 50 verified user ratings. The RT Audience Summary is still pending.Disclaimer: The trailer below includes minor cursing.What Are Individual Critics Saying About ‘Something Very Bad Is About To Happen’?Alison Herman of Variety is among the top critics on RT who gives Something Very Bad is Going to Happen a “fresh” score. Herman writes in her RT review summary, “Would this work better as a movie, compressing all the events into a single weekend? ... I don’t have the answers. I just enjoyed parts of Something Very Bad enough to crave a structure that was better suited to showing them off.”Angie Han of The Hollywood Reporter also is a fan of Something Very Bad is Going to Happen, writing in her RT review summary, “The show excels at casting a spell through odd details, nasty red herrings, disturbing clues. And underlying them all is an unexpectedly sincere exploration of what true love can or should feel like.”Forbes‘Avatar: Fire And Ash’ Gets Streaming Release DateBy Tim LammersIn her “fresh” review summary of Something Very Bad is Going to Happen on RT, Anita Singh of the Daily Telegraph writes, “It’s macabre and unsettling and filled with people dying in a particularly alarming way (if you faint at the sight of blood, give this a miss), but there’s a knowingness to it all, a gleeful smorgasbord of genre tropes.”Matthew Creith of The Wrap is among the top critics on RT who deem Something Very Bad is Going to Happen “rotten.” Creith writes in his RT review summary, "Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen lives up to its threatening title, but perhaps not in the way Boston and the Duffer Brothers intended.”Forbes‘Wuthering Heights’ Gets Streaming Release DateBy Tim LammersNick Schager of The Daily Beast also gives Something Very Bad is Going to Happen a “rotten” score, writing in his RT review summary, “Too often, the answers it provides are as underwhelming as its action is woefully underlit.”John Anderson isn’t a fan of the series either. Anderson writes in his RT review summary, “There’s a lot going on, including a spinning of wheels. It may not be ‘very bad,’ I hasten to add, but the ‘something very bad’ in Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen is the pumping of 10 gallons of horror into a 5-gallon vehicle.”Rated TV-MA, Something Very Bad is Going to Happen is streaming on Netflix.ForbesChris Hemsworth And Halle Berry’s ‘Crime 101’ Gets Prime Video Date, Report SaysBy Tim Lammers
